privileged_info_for_vlm: The target sequence is BRCA1 Exon 11. Standard SpCas9 settings require a 20bp target length and an NGG PAM (total 23bp). On the forward strand, the sequence must end in 'GG'; on the reverse strand, the target sequence (as viewed on the forward strand) must start with 'CC' (the complement of the 3' NGG). Expected output paths: ~/UGENE_Data/crispr/results/BRCA1_crispr.gb, ~/UGENE_Data/crispr/results/crispr_targets.csv, and ~/UGENE_Data/crispr/results/design_summary.txt.
